readme: AI Era Cyber Training Catalogue v16
Current lifecycle release: 2 November 2026. 516 active resources (403 Offers and 113 Tool track), plus the saved AI use cases internal brief. 18 user-approved retirements.

Offers and Tool track default to Lifecycle = Active. Clear that filter to inspect retired records. Retirements records the approved IDs, reasons, date and sources. Historical rows, source references and assessment scores are retained.

Current apps import active resources only. Scores, Coverage, Paths, Path detail, Matrix and audit sheets preserve historical assessments/planning; they are not the active curriculum. The capability model and Recommended Training Pathways remain the curriculum authorities.

18 resources retired: model-specific o1/Llama editions, PaLM/Assistants/AutoGen editions, four AI-900 entries, four old OWASP editions and two historical references plus Practical GenAI. No scores or evidence have been reassessed.

Active resources retain 56,140 numerical outcome scores and 280 explicitly unassessed rows. All 140 outcomes and 23 scoring groups remain unchanged. Historical assessment sheets retain their original 58,100 scores and 9,591 course/need rows.
